rows.jp: そして俺は、逃げ戻った。

ghs.en: And then I escaped back to where I came from.

rows.en: I could not afford to fail.

ghs.assessment: Following the statement that failure is not allowed, this emphatically means 'never' or 'under no circumstances.' The English instead means 'in all respects.'

rows.jp: 慎重に行かねばならない。
rows.en: I had to proceed with care.

ghs.en: I must proceed carefully, without fail.

rows.jp: 瞬間的にふくれあがった、悪意。
rows.en: The malice had swelled inside me in an instant.

ghs.en: It was a momentary swelling of malice.

rows.jp: 思春期の性欲のようなそれを、吐き出すのは容易ではない。
rows.en: Like adolescent lust, it was not easily spent.

ghs.en: It is something so like the sexual desire of puberty that, and vomiting it out is not trivial.

rows.jp: 俺は残る日数を自宅で過ごした。
rows.en: I passed the remaining days at home.

ghs.en: I spent the leftover days at my home.

rows.jp: 誰とも接触しなかった。
rows.en: I had no contact with anyone.

ghs.en: I had no contact with anybody,

rows.jp: 危険はおかしたくなかったからだ。
rows.en: I didn’t want to take the risk.

ghs.en: because I did want to take the risk of trespassing into something dangerous.
ghs.assessment: Taichi says he did not want to take any risks. The English reverses the polarity and invents trespassing into something dangerous.
ghs.remedy: because I didn't want to take any risks

highlights.text: did want to take the risk of trespassing into something dangerous

rows.jp: 俺は静かに時を待った。
rows.en: I waited quietly for the time to come.

ghs.en: I waited for the time in silence.

rows.jp: その後の皆が、どう過ごしたのかはわからない。
rows.en: I do not know how the others spent those days.

ghs.en: How all the ones that remained passed their time after that, I have no idea.

rows.jp: 幾度、皆の個別はかき消されたのだろう？
rows.en: How many times had each of their separate selves been erased?

ghs.en: How many times has everyone's individuality been erased by now?

rows.jp: その重い事実は、俺を眩ませた。
rows.en: That terrible fact made my head swim.

ghs.en: The weight of that truth dazzled and disoriented me.
